feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: G7 countries reluctantly agree to tap their fuel reserves to help the U.S.
entry.summary: G7 nations plan to release large amounts of diesel fuel soon, but European countries were not entirely happy about the agreement.

entry.title: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
entry.summary: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.

entry.title: Economist Betsey Stevenson breaks down the gender gap in recent hiring reports
entry.summary: The U.S. economy added fewer jobs than expected last month and unemployment ticked up to 4.2%. NPR's Scott Simon talks to Betsey Stevenson, an economist at the University of Michigan.

entry.title: Pro-Trump Influencer Benny Johnson is being sued for defamation by ICE protesters
entry.summary: The lawsuit says the prominent conservative podcaster falsely claimed the protesters were assaulting ICE officers during demonstrations at an ICE facility in Illinois last year.

entry.title: The U.S. added only 29,000 jobs in September as job market lacks spark
entry.summary: U.S. employers added 29,000 jobs in September as the unemployment rate inched up to 4.2%. Job gains for July and August were revised down by a total of 60,000 jobs, extending a lackluster run for the job market.

entry.title: Why is diesel more expensive than regular gas?
entry.summary: Diesel hasn't always been more expensive than other gasoline. Then in 2004, a switch happened due to air quality standards, demand, and taxes. In this week's Indicator newsletter, we dig into diesel prices, what kind of fun people are buying, and other forms of making your tax bill smaller.

entry.title: San Francisco's car crime has plunged. How much credit does Flock deserve?
entry.summary: San Francisco leaders say AI-powered cameras helped drive a dramatic decline in car crime. We examine the evidence — and whether the city can keep its high-tech dragnet without sacrificing civil liberties.

entry.title: The U.S. Senate is up for grabs. Can this Ohio Democrat win back working-class votes?
entry.summary: After 32 years in Congress, Ohio's Sherrod Brown lost his Senate seat in 2024 as many working class voters turned out for Trump. Now Brown is counting on union voters to send him back to Washington.

entry.title: Breweries adapt as tastes in beer change
entry.summary: The craft beer market is saturated and tastes are changing. Brewers are coming with innovative ways to attract customers.

entry.title: Google launches Project Suncatcher, a step towards AI data centers in space
entry.summary: The fridge-size satellite with AI chips on board is part of Project Suncatcher, the company's moonshot effort to put AI data centers in space and harness solar energy.
